Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Sugar Land, Texas, when Driver 2 attempted a lane
change into the same space and made contact with the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported pain in the
neck and lower back immediately after the impact and was assisted at the scene. Passenger was also present in the
vehicle at the time of the collision, and both the responding officer and the statements taken at the scene confirm that
Driver 1 was the operator. Damage to the left side of Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with a sideswipe of this type, and
the nature of the impact is consistent with the injuries described. Officers reviewed scene photographs, which show
some of the damage and positions of the vehicles, though no independent witnesses came forward to describe the
collision. Driver 1 is listed as an insured driver on the policy covering the vehicle. No prior damage to the veihcle has
been identified in the records reviewed at the scene.
